title: Rice and Pea Pulao
subtitle: with carrot and warm spices
description: A fragrant pulao of basmati rice and tender peas cooked with carrot, cumin, coriander and cardamom, finished with fresh tomato.

steps.text: Soak the peas for 12 hours in plenty of water (quick-cook organic peas need no soaking). Drain. Soak the basmati rice in water for 30 minutes and drain.
Put the peas in a pot with plenty of lukewarm water and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and cook covered for 45 minutes (quick-cook peas) or 1.5 hours (regular) until soft and crumbly. Drain.
Heat the oil in a pot and fry the chopped onion, grated carrot, garlic, chilli and spices with salt and white pepper for 5 minutes until the onion is soft and translucent.
Add the peas and rice and fry for 1 to 2 minutes. Pour in 3 cups boiling water and cook covered for 20 minutes over low heat.
Turn off the heat, add the tomatoes cut into quarters, rest covered for 10 minutes, and fluff with a fork.
